author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the trailer for the Unico Traveller ULW10 portable display. Unico Traveller ULW10 features a 10-inch 4:3 retro-inspired display, RGBs input for classic gaming hardware, VGA input for vintage PCs and compatible hardware, HDMI input for modern consoles and devices, physical RGB color adjustment controls, physical display and menu controls, integrated speaker, built-in rear compartment for compatible consoles, cables and accessories, integrated carrying handles for portability, and it is available in multiple color options.

Designed for those who still own the consoles and games they grew up with, the ULW10 brings classic hardware back into the modern setup with a portable, PVM-inspired 4:3 display built for generations of gaming.

A Kickstarter campaign for the Unico Traveller ULW10 is now live.
title: Unico Traveller ULW10 - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join the developers at Firaxis for a deep dive into the Arc of Tomorrow update and the Earthrise expansion for Civilization 7 in this latest video for the strategy game. The Arc of Tomorrow update introduces the Atomic Age, a new fourth Age spanning approximately the 1950s through the 2050s, featuring a reimagining of Civilization's approach to nuclear strategy, with new offensive and defensive options and units, new buildings, new visuals, new music, new civilizations, new leaders, and more. 

The first expansion, Earthrise, explores humanity’s relationship with space and the environment across the entire campaign, culminating in space agencies and missions throughout the solar system.

Civilization 7 is available now on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store). The Arc of Tomorrow update and the Earthrise expansion will be available in 2027.
title: Civilization 7 - Official Next Major Update & First Expansion: Behind-The-Scenes

description:

From the trailer's official description: Raider efforts have revealed clues to the mystery of phantom ARC signals that have Shani concerned. Rumor has it Apollo’s working on an experimental solution, and he’s requested assistance from Raiders who understand schematics, and can keep their heads down.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get another look at your adventure, characters, combat, and more from Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories in this latest trailer for the upcoming RPG. Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories will be available on Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Windows PC via Steam, and Xbox Series X|S on February 25, 2027.

Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories introduces you to amnesiac alchemist Karia and her companions Servio Lektor, Fina Rozen, and fellow alchemist Yumia Liessfeldt on a quest of discovery and growth. Throughout your journey, you will also encounter additional characters, including Noelk Schreiber, an aloof inspector from the Eustellan Bureau of Alchemical Relic Control, and Celes, a woman who appears calm and collected but has a peculiar side of her personality. Together, they endeavor to explore Aladiss’ mysterious underworld and uncover its secret.
title: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories - Official Trailer #2
